q1.question: What services does Kendy Digital offer?
q1.answer: Kendy Digital offers CapCut plans, Facebook accounts, upgrades, and Facebook advertising services based on your needs.

q2.question: Do I need an account to make a purchase?
q2.answer: Yes. An account helps store order history, wallet balance, delivery details, and post-purchase support tickets.

q3.question: Where can I view my orders?
q3.answer: After logging in, you can view your order code, processing status, delivery notes, and support ticket history in your dashboard.

q1.question: How long does a deposit take to show in my wallet?
q1.answer: If you transfer with the correct amount and note, your wallet is updated quickly. Some bank transactions may take longer depending on timing.

q2.question: What if I write the wrong transfer note?
q2.answer: Please create a support ticket with a receipt screenshot, amount, and transfer time so our team can check and verify manually.

q3.question: Are faulty orders refundable?
q3.answer: If the issue falls under our warranty terms or the service cannot be delivered as described, a refund is issued to your wallet and logged.

q1.question: What do I receive after buying CapCut?
q1.answer: You will receive delivery credentials or login/upgrade instructions depending on your chosen plan in your order details.

q2.question: What information do I need to provide?
q2.answer: Depending on the plan, you may need to provide your email address, target account credentials, or specific processing notes.

q3.question: Can I change my plan after purchase?
q3.answer: If you wish to upgrade or switch plans, create a ticket with your order code. Support will check eligibility and process price differences.

q1.question: Which Facebook account type should I choose?
q1.answer: You should describe your industry, advertising needs, and budget so our consulting team can recommend the best option before purchase.

q2.question: Is revenue guaranteed when running ads?
q2.answer: No. We do not guarantee specific revenues. Our service focuses on professional setup, optimization, transparent reporting, and data-driven suggestions.

q3.question: Under what conditions is warranty voided?
q3.answer: Issues caused by user guidelines violation, platform policy breaches, or illegal behavior are excluded from warranty.
